breakdown.description: The prompt uses the wrong isotropic relation for the shear modulus; for linear isotropic elasticity, G = E/[2(1 + ν)].
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified and replaced the incorrect formula for the shear modulus (G = E/(1 + ν)) with the correct one for isotropic linear elasticity (G = E / (2 * (1 + ν))).

breakdown.description: The prompt sets ε_z to zero just because σ_z = 0, even though plane-stress states generally still develop an out-of-plane strain through Poisson coupling.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the flawed instruction to set ε_z = 0. Instead, it correctly applied generalized Hooke's law to calculate the non-zero out-of-plane strain ε_z, which arises from the Poisson effect of the in-plane stresses (σx and σy).
